tables.name: depth_model_benchmarks
tables.units: params in millions; latency ms per image; DA-2K accuracy %; delta1 and AbsRel unitless
rows: Depth Anything V2 (ablation: labelled synthetic only)
Depth Anything V2 (ablation: pseudo-labelled real only)
tables.population: General indoor/outdoor scene benchmarks (DA-2K, NYU-D, SUN-RGBD); no face data. Latency hardware not stated.
tables.notes: Values come from search-result summaries of the papers; independent cross-check was not possible (search budget exhausted). DA V2 ViT-L NYU-D protocol (zero-shot vs fine-tuned) unknown. DA3Metric-Large param count is from a community wrapper. DA3-metric also reported 2nd best on DIODE (value not retrieved).

tables.name: normal_model_benchmarks
tables.units: mean angular error in degrees; training images count
tables.population: NYUv2 indoor scenes; no face data
tables.notes: Status 'verified' applies to the 16.4 deg NYUv2 error only (cited by two independent later papers). Training image counts (~160K vs >12M) are single-source with unclear attribution; Omnidata-V2 figure is a lower bound ('over 12M').

tables.name: sapiens_human_depth_normal
tables.population: Full-body human datasets (Hi4D, THuman2); face region not reported
tables.notes: Baselines for the relative improvements were not verified. A claimed 500K synthetic fine-tuning set was excluded because its attribution was unclear.

tables.name: da3_metric_conversion
tables.units: focal in pixels; output in model metric unit
tables.notes: Depth is linear in the supplied focal: a fractional focal error produces the same fractional depth error. Output unit was not confirmed from the snippet.
